latin: Per ultimam propositionem Abucaten possumus intelligere quid sibi uelit illa diuisio quam fecit Plato in principio tractatus Timei, et possumus scire quod sub ea non comprehenditur anima nisi per uiam extremalis conbinationis.
translation: Abucaten's final proposition lets us grasp the point of the division Plato draws at the start of the Timaeus, and lets us see that the soul falls under it only by way of a combination of the two extremes.
